001package edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.service;
002
003import com.google.android.gms.auth.api.signin.GoogleSignInAccount;
004import edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.model.dao.UserDao;
005import edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.model.entity.User;
006import io.reactivex.rxjava3.core.Scheduler;
007import io.reactivex.rxjava3.core.Single;
008import io.reactivex.rxjava3.schedulers.Schedulers;
009import javax.inject.Inject;
010import javax.inject.Singleton;
011
012/**
013 * @noinspection deprecation
014 */
015
016/**
017 * A repository class responsible for handling operations related to user accounts and user data.
018 * This class acts as the main access point for managing users, providing seamless integration
019 * between Google Sign-In authentication and local database operations.
020 *
021 * This class is managed as a singleton and is constructed using dependency injection.
022 */
023@Singleton
024public class UserRepository {
025
026  private final GoogleSignInService signInService;
027  private final UserDao userDao;
028  private final Scheduler scheduler;
029
030  /**
031   * Constructs a UserRepository instance with dependencies for managing Google Sign-In services
032   * and user data persistence operations.
033   *
034   * @param signInService An instance of {@link GoogleSignInService} used to handle authentication
035   *                      and session management for Google Sign-In.
036   * @param userDao       An instance of {@link UserDao} used to perform persistent data operations
037   *                      related to user accounts, such as querying and updating user records.
038   */
039  @Inject
040  UserRepository(GoogleSignInService signInService, UserDao userDao) {
041    this.signInService = signInService;
042    this.userDao = userDao;
043    scheduler = Schedulers.io();
044  }
045
046  // TODO: 2/26/25 Add operations (methods) for reading and writing users from/to a database.
047
048  /**
049   * Retrieves the current Google Sign-In account information asynchronously. This method
050   * performs a silent sign-in operation using the Google Sign-In service and observes the
051   * result on the configured scheduler.
052   *
053   * @return A {@link Single} emitting the currently signed-in {@link GoogleSignInAccount}, or
054   * an error if the sign-in attempt fails.
055   */
056  public Single<GoogleSignInAccount> getCurrentAccount() {
057    return signInService
058        .refresh()
059        .observeOn(scheduler);
060  }
061
062  /**
063   * Retrieves the currently authenticated user from the database or creates a new user
064   * if the user does not exist in the database. This method first attempts to fetch the
065   * signed-in account using the Google Sign-In service. If the user's associated record
066   * is not found in the database, it creates a new {@code User} instance, initializes its
067   * properties (OAuth key and display name), stores it in the database, and returns it.
068   *
069   * @return A {@link Single} emitting the {@link User} associated with the currently signed-in
070   * account. If no record is found in the database, a new {@link User} is created and returned.
071   * An error is emitted if the retrieval or creation process fails.
072   */
073  public Single<User> getCurrentUser() {
074    return getCurrentAccount()
075        .flatMap((account) -> {
076          String oauthkey = account.getId();
077          return userDao
078              .select(oauthkey)
079              .switchIfEmpty(
080                  Single.fromSupplier(User::new)
081                      .doOnSuccess((user) -> {
082                        user.setOauthKey(oauthkey);
083                        user.setDisplayName(account.getDisplayName());
084                      })
085                      .flatMap(userDao::insertAndReturn)
086              );
087        });
088  }
089}
